newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine budget surplus falls in June.
newsitem.headline: Philippine budget surplus falls in June.

text.p: The Philippine government cash budget surplus at end-June fell 8.7 percent to 4.49 billion pesos from the previous month, the Bureau of Treasury said on Wednesday.
Revenues during the first six months were 216.22 billion pesos while expenditures were 211.73 billion.
The figure compares to a targetted 8.04 billion peso suplus for the period.
In the period, the government retired 17.54 billion pesos of outstnading debt, of which 8.18 billion was foreign debt.
That left a cash balance of 118.17 billion pesos, compared to 131.58 billion at the end of 1996.
The tax shortfall was 6.54 billion pesos, an improvement on the 11.21 billion under target at the end of May.
Customs income was 41.46 billion pesos, below target by 10.77 billion.
However, the Bureau of Treasury said it exceeded its target by 634 million pesos to contribute 6.75 billion pesos to the national coffers.
